specification.input_notes: The Zenodo record 15007585 provides PLINK-format genotype files (c1global1nfd_public.bed/.bim/.fam) and individual metadata (c1global1nfd_public.indiv_meta) for the human data set. The wolf data set is referenced to Dryad c9b25 and p8cz8wb18, but those deposits list no files. The simulation inputs are generated by code (msprime) and are not deposited as data files.

specification.comparison_metric: Compare the reported proportion (100%) and its Clopper-Pearson 95% confidence interval [93%, 100%] against the solver's recomputed proportion and interval from the same simulation replicates.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Proportions compared by numerator/denominator; the reported 100% corresponds to 50/50 replicates, and the interval must match the Clopper-Pearson interval at the reported precision.
specification.specification_gaps: The exact random seeds and replicate ordering for the 50 simulation replicates are not specified; the precise grid registration and deme assignment details are only partially described; the exact SNP subsetting to 1,000 independent SNPs is not fully specified.
